intro_html: All the flavor of taco night, built for the week ahead. Lean ground turkey, rice, black beans, and corn get a taco-seasoned kick and a melt of cheddar. It is filling, high in protein, and it reheats like a dream. Scoop it into a bowl, over lettuce, or into a tortilla, and you have lunch handled for days.
cost_closing_html: About $3.65 a bowl (at everyday cost) versus $11 or more for a fast-casual burrito bowl. Catch turkey on sale and it drops further.
portion_html: Set the full pot on your scale and subtract the empty-pot weight from Step 1. Divide that total by 14 and scoop the exact amount into each container. Every bowl lands near 488 calories and 34 grams of protein.
upsell_html: High-protein dinners for about $3.65 a bowl (at everyday cost). This is one of many. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons, calculators, and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Turkey and beef are interchangeable here. Whichever is cheaper that week wins. Turkey runs leaner, beef runs a touch cheaper on sale.
Buy the ground meat on sale and freeze it in one-pound packs. Same rule that makes every batch cheaper over time.
Beans and corn by the case are pennies cheaper per can and you will use them again next week.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Cook the rice. Three and a half cups dry jasmine with water per the package, then set aside.
Brown the ground turkey in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the taco seasoning and a splash of water and stir until coated.
Drain and rinse the beans and corn, then warm them through.
Combine the rice, turkey, beans, and corn in your big pot and stir. Fold in the shredded cheddar.

head.description: A lean ground turkey, rice, black bean, and corn taco skillet meal prep. Fourteen servings at about 488 calories and 34 grams of protein for roughly $3.65 each (at everyday cost).
head.keywords: high protein meal prep, cheap meal prep, ground turkey, taco bowl, budget dinner
recipeIngredient: 4 cans, drained Sweet Whole Kernel Corn
about 1 3/4 cups shredded (~7 oz) Fat Free Cheddar
steps: Cook 3.5 cups dry jasmine rice per the package and set aside.
Brown the ground turkey in a large skillet, breaking it up.
Stir in the taco seasoning with a splash of water.
Drain and warm the beans and corn.
Combine rice, turkey, beans, and corn and fold in the cheddar.
Weigh the batch and divide into 14 containers.
